remarks: Quiet cul-de-sac in the Cove area of Stamford offers a fabulous investment opportunity or option to live in one unit & rent the other. First floor unit has been totally renovated with new kitchen, floors, bath. Light & bright living room offers lots of space as well as area for dining. Currently has tenant in place.Lovely sized bedrooms with plenty of space. Upstairs unit has had same tenant for 21 years, but is willing to sign a lease for $2800. It is in need of updates and is not well maintained at this time by tenants.  No showings of 2nd floor apartment unless serious interest at a second visit.Property being sold AS IS
